collection.description: During a gathering, a child asks whether a chief who makes mistakes should still be obeyed.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During a gathering, (child) asks whether a {@chief} who makes mistakes should still be obeyed.

choices.label: Ask for Examples from Village History

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The {@chief} admits that leaders can be wrong and should listen.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The {@chief} struggles with the question but later offers a more thoughtful response.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) learns why immediate safety instructions differ from ordinary preferences.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The adults realize they have not explained how decisions can be challenged.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) recalls a leader who corrected an unpopular decision.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Two elders remember the same dispute differently, to everyone's amusement.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) voices a concern without being punished for asking.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The discussion ends unresolved, but (child) feels taken seriously.
